process_area.title: Mystery Shopping, Service Audit & Measurement Operations

value_stream.name: Customer Mystery Shopping & Service Quality Assurance Program

fields.Participants: Service Quality, Vendor/Shoppers, CX (VS-13), Store Ops (VS-07), Privacy (VS-91)

workflows.name: Mystery-Shop Visit Scheduling, Scenario & Shopper Deployment

Automation Opportunity: - Randomized scheduling engine; scenario-shopper auto-match; coverage-completion dashboard; integrity monitoring
Controls: - CTL-669 (ensure controlled execution — Mystery Shopping, Service Audit & Measurement Operations (PA-146.2).)
- CTL-669: visits randomized & rotated; shoppers profile-matched; coverage & integrity monitored (W4381)
Cross-references: - links to VS-34 (vendor), VS-91 (privacy), VS-13 (CX), W4363 (methodology), W4367 (privacy), W4381 (integrity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Predictability risk**: schedule detected → gamed performance; mitigated by randomized scheduling & shopper rotation
- **Shopper-mismatch risk**: shopper profile unrealistic → compromised validity; mitigated by profile-scenario match

steps.activity: Service Quality/Vendor generate the randomized visit schedule — store/time/associate coverage per methodology (W4363), scenario assignment, and shopper-profile match
Vendor deploy & brief shoppers on the scenario script, evidence-capture protocol (W4367), conduct code (W4365), and submit timeline
Service Quality monitor coverage completion, manage no-shows/replacements, and ensure randomization/integrity (W4381)

fields.Participants: Shopper, Service Quality, Store Ops (VS-07) [unaware], CX (VS-13)

workflows.name: In-Store Mystery Shopping Execution & Evidence Capture

Automation Opportunity: - Shopper reporting app with rubric; lawful-evidence capture; timed-behavior logging; auto-submit to validation
Controls: - CTL-669 (ensure controlled execution — Mystery Shopping, Service Audit & Measurement Operations (PA-146.2).)
- CTL-669: scenario per rubric (W4362); evidence within lawful limits (W4367); report submitted timely
Cross-references: - links to VS-91 (privacy), VS-13 (CX), W4362 (rubric), W4367 (privacy), W4375 (validation/scoring), W4381 (integrity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Detection risk**: shopper recognized → gamed service; mitigated by shopper rotation & profile-realism
- **Evidence-unlawfulness risk**: evidence captured beyond consent → privacy violation; mitigated by lawful-limits protocol (W4367)
System Touchpoints: - Service-quality/evidence system (W4368); privacy (VS-91); CX (VS-13); store ops (VS-07)

steps.activity: Shopper execute the in-store scenario (greeting, inquiry, product-knowledge probe, consultative-selling test, checkout, return/complaint W4373), observing the rubric (W4362)
Shopper capture evidence within lawful limits (W4367) — observed behaviors, timings (queue/wait), and permitted photo/audio per consent
Shopper submit the completed shop report + evidence to the system (W4368) within timeline, for validation/scoring (W4375)

fields.Participants: Service Quality, Ecommerce (VS-10), Digital/App (VS-75), CX (VS-13), Marketplace (VS-65)

workflows.name: Omnichannel, Ecommerce & Digital Mystery-Shop & Service Test

Automation Opportunity: - Automated digital-journey testing; content-accuracy scan; cross-channel consistency check; auto-scoring
Controls: - CTL-669 (ensure controlled execution — Mystery Shopping, Service Audit & Measurement Operations (PA-146.2).)
- CTL-669: omnichannel scenarios per rubric; content-accuracy tested; cross-channel consistency checked
Cross-references: - links to VS-10 (ecommerce), VS-75 (app), VS-65 (marketplace), VS-137 (content), VS-13 (CX), W4362 (rubric), W4375 (scoring), W4377 (remediation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Channel-blind-spot risk**: digital service un-measured → drift; mitigated by omnichannel coverage
- **Content-accuracy risk**: wrong product content misleads customers; mitigated by content-accuracy test (links VS-137)
System Touchpoints: - Ecommerce (VS-10); app/digital (VS-75); marketplace (VS-65); CX (VS-13); service-quality system (W4368)

steps.a: Head of Service Quality / Ecommerce Lead
steps.activity: Service Quality/Ecommerce design the omnichannel test scenarios — site/app search, product-content accuracy, checkout, BOPIS pickup (VS-10), delivery (VS-143), marketplace (VS-65), digital support
Shopper/tester execute the digital journey, capture evidence (screenshots, timings, content accuracy), and test cross-channel consistency
Service Quality score the omnichannel service vs rubric (W4362), validate (W4375), and feed findings to ecommerce/digital remediation (W4377)

fields.Participants: Service Quality, Trade/Field Sales (VS-11/VS-140), Contact Center (VS-13.1), CX (VS-13), Key Account (VS-107)

Automation Opportunity: - B2B scenario scripts; contact-center call-audit (consented); auto-scoring; findings-to-remediation workflow
Controls: - CTL-669: B2B/contact-center scenarios per rubric; call evidence consented (W4367); scored & validated
Cross-references: - links to VS-11/VS-140 (trade/field), VS-13.1 (contact center), VS-107 (key account), VS-13 (CX), W4362 (rubric), W4367 (consent), W4377 (remediation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **B2B-blind-spot risk**: B2B service un-measured → account churn; mitigated by B2B coverage
- **Consent risk**: recording contact-center calls without consent; mitigated by consent/notice protocol (W4367)
System Touchpoints: - Trade (VS-11/VS-140); contact center (VS-13.1); key account (VS-107); CX (VS-13); service-quality system (W4368)

steps.activity: Service Quality/Trade design B2B & contact-center audit scenarios — trade quote/inquiry (VS-11/VS-140), key-account engagement (VS-107), field-sales visit, phone/chat/email support (VS-13.1)
Auditor/shopper execute the B2B/contact-center scenario (quote accuracy, responsiveness, product knowledge, solution-selling), capture evidence (within consent W4367)
Service Quality score vs rubric (W4362), validate (W4375), and feed findings to B2B/contact-center remediation (W4377)

fields.Participants: Service Quality, CX (VS-13), Returns (VS-32), Store Ops (VS-07), Customer Service

Automation Opportunity: - Recovery-test scripts (fairness-validated); recovery-effectiveness scoring; findings-to-training workflow
Controls: - CTL-669: recovery tests fair (W4365); recovery effectiveness scored; findings fed to recovery improvement (W4377)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-32 (returns), VS-07 (store), W4362 (rubric), W4365 (ethics/fairness), W4377 (remediation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fraud-risk**: recovery-test perceived as fraudulent claim → unfair; mitigated by fairness framework (W4365) & test-design
- **Recovery-blind-spot risk**: weak recovery → churn; mitigated by recovery coverage
System Touchpoints: - CX (VS-13); returns (VS-32); store ops (VS-07); service-quality system (W4368)

steps.a: Head of Service Quality / CX Lead
steps.activity: Service Quality/CX design recovery-test scenarios — simulated complaint, return/refund request (VS-32), escalation, apology/empowerment, follow-up — to test recovery effectiveness
Shopper execute the recovery scenario (within fairness W4365 — no fraudulent claim), observe the recovery response (empathy, empowerment, resolution, follow-up), capture evidence

steps.a: Head of Service Quality / CX Lead
steps.activity: Service Quality/CX score recovery vs rubric (W4362), validate (W4375), and feed findings to recovery-training/policy (W4377)

fields.Owner: Service Quality / Store Ops (VS-07) / Regional Ops
fields.Participants: Service Quality, Regional/Store Ops (VS-07), CX (VS-13), HSE (VS-24)

workflows.name: Internal Service Audit, Store Walkthrough & Standards Compliance Check

Automation Opportunity: - Audit-checklist app; immediate-finding logging; internal-vs-mystery correlation analytics
Controls: - CTL-669: internal audit per rubric; reconciled to mystery-shop; immediate findings logged
Cross-references: - links to VS-07 (store ops), VS-13 (CX), VS-24 (HSE), W4362 (rubric), W4370 (mystery-shop), W4377 (remediation)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Self-report-bias risk**: announced audits show gamed performance; mitigated by correlation with un-announced mystery-shop (W4370)
- **Standards-drift risk**: standards un-checked between visits; mitigated by periodic internal audit
System Touchpoints: - Store ops (VS-07); service-quality system (W4368); CX (VS-13); HSE (VS-24)

steps.activity: Service Quality/Regional Ops conduct announced/scheduled internal service-audit & walkthrough — standards compliance (cleanliness, signage, queue, service behavior, safety VS-24) per rubric (W4362)
Auditor capture compliance vs standard, discuss immediate findings with store leadership, and log to the system (W4368)
Service Quality/Store Ops reconcile internal-audit vs mystery-shop results (correlation, divergence), and feed to operations/HR (W4377)

workflows.name: Service-Quality Data Validation, Scoring & Quality Control

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-validation (completeness/evidence); rubric-based scoring; inter-rater reliability analytics; outlier/fabrication detection
Controls: - CTL-669 (ensure controlled execution — Mystery Shopping, Service Audit & Measurement Operations (PA-146.2).)
- CTL-669: reports validated & evidence-checked; scored per rubric; QC'd for consistency & integrity (W4381)
Cross-references: - links to VS-21 (quality), VS-28 (BI), VS-34 (vendor), W4362 (rubric), W4364 (KPI), W4376 (triage), W4381 (integrity)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scoring-inconsistency risk**: inconsistent scoring → unreliable comparison; mitigated by rubric & inter-rater reliability QC
- **Fabricated-data risk**: fabricated shop reports; mitigated by validation, evidence-spot-check, integrity controls (W4381)

steps.activity: Service Quality/Vendor validate each submitted report — completeness, evidence presence/quality, rubric-alignment, and plausibility (vs integrity W4381)
Service Quality score the report vs the rubric (W4362/KPI W4364), apply weighting, and aggregate to touchpoint/store/region scores
Quality/BI run batch QC (inter-rater reliability, outlier detection, evidence-spot-check), flag anomalies, and quarantine suspect data (W4381)

fields.Participants: Service Quality, CX (VS-13), Store Ops (VS-07), HR (VS-103), Ethics (VS-119), Leadership

Automation Opportunity: - Severity auto-classification; routing rules; critical-finding auto-escalation; closure-tracking dashboard
Controls: - CTL-669 (ensure controlled execution — Mystery Shopping, Service Audit & Measurement Operations (PA-146.2).)
- CTL-669: findings tried by severity; critical escalated per governance (W4365); closure tracked; dispute path available (W4380)
Cross-references: - links to VS-13 (CX), VS-07 (store), VS-103 (HR), VS-119 (ethics), W4365 (governance), W4377 (remediation), W4380 (dispute)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Triage-error risk**: mis-classified severity → under/over-escalation; mitigated by severity rubric & review
- **No-closure risk**: findings not actioned/closed → repeat failure; mitigated by closure tracking
System Touchpoints: - Service-quality system (W4368); CX (VS-13); store ops (VS-07); HR (VS-103); ethics (VS-119)

steps.activity: Service Quality triage each finding — severity (critical/major/minor), type (behavior, knowledge, process, recovery, compliance), and the responsible unit/store/associate
Service Quality escalate critical/major findings (safety, legal, ethics, repeat-critical) to the right owner (Store Ops/HR/Ethics/Leadership) per governance (W4365)
Service Quality route all findings to feedback/remediation (W4377) and track to closure, with dispute/appeal path (W4380)
